title: Grade 4 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Termly Exam #17 (Term 2)

pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #17 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does the Gayatri Mantra compare wisdom to? (1 mark)
   A. A river
   B. Light
   C. A drum
   D. A mountain

2. How should you receive prasad? (1 mark)
   A. With your right hand or both hands, and say thank you
   B. With your left hand only
   C. By snatching
   D. By refusing rudely

3. Which words begin the well-known Saraswati Vandana? (1 mark)
   A. Ya Kundendu Tushara Hara Dhavala
   B. Twameva mata cha pita twameva
   C. Om Bhur Bhuvah Svah
   D. Om Namah Shivaya

4. What greeting shows respect with folded hands? (1 mark)
   A. Sat Sri Akal
   B. Shalom
   C. Hujambo
   D. Namaste

5. In Twameva Mata cha Pita Twameva, whom does the prayer speak to? (1 mark)
   A. A tree
   B. God
   C. A river
   D. A king

6. What is the lesson of the Harishchandra story? (1 mark)
   A. Lies are useful
   B. Wealth is everything
   C. Promises are not important
   D. Truth is worth more than wealth or comfort

7. How did the boy in the example story practise Asteya? (1 mark)
   A. He sold the purse
   B. He found the owner of the purse
   C. He kept the money
   D. He hid the purse

8. What should you do if you break something at school? (1 mark)
   A. Give it away
   B. Own up
   C. Run away
   D. Blame another child

9. Which best describes a person with integrity? (1 mark)
   A. Honest even when nobody is watching
   B. Rich
   C. Honest only when watched
   D. Loud

10. What is a common mistake about lies? (1 mark)
   A. Thinking honesty is important
   B. Owning up
   C. Returning items
   D. Thinking small lies do not matter

11. How should learners who return lost items be treated? (1 mark)
   A. They should be punished
   B. They should be thanked
   C. They should be laughed at
   D. They should be ignored

12. Which king is known for always telling the truth in a Hindu story? (1 mark)
   A. Harishchandra
   B. Kansa
   C. Ravan
   D. Hiranyakashipu

13. Which faith's story in the lesson is about honest earnings? (1 mark)
   A. Hinduism
   B. Buddhism
   C. Sikhism
   D. Jainism

14. Who was Bhai Lalo? (1 mark)
   A. A Jain monk
   B. A shopkeeper in Nairobi
   C. A king of Ayodhya
   D. An honest carpenter in the Guru Nanak story

15. What should be written when an item is put in the lost and found? (1 mark)
   A. The date and the finder's name
   B. A secret code
   C. Nothing
   D. The price

16. How does the breath in happen in Kapaal Bhaati? (1 mark)
   A. By humming
   B. By hand
   C. By force
   D. By itself

17. What should you wear for yoga? (1 mark)
   A. Loose and comfortable clothes
   B. Heavy boots
   C. A raincoat
   D. Tight clothes

18. Which pose do you start Sasankasana from? (1 mark)
   A. Lying down
   B. A handstand
   C. Standing
   D. Vajra Asana

19. Which is a benefit of yoga? (1 mark)
   A. It gives instant riches
   B. It helps us breathe well and stay calm
   C. It stops rain
   D. It makes us noisy

20. How can children with special needs take part? (1 mark)
   A. By leaving
   B. In their own way, such as breathing slowly or seated poses
   C. Only by watching
   D. They cannot join

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Suggest four activities for celebrating International Yoga Day in school. (4 marks)

22. Give two safety rules for yoga. (2 marks)

23. State what the Gayatri Mantra asks God to give us. (2 marks)

24. Explain how a person shows integrity when handling money. (3 marks)

25. Describe how to do Sasankasana. (4 marks)

26. Write the meaning of Twameva Mata cha Pita Twameva. (3 marks)

27. What is Pranayam? (2 marks)

28. A shopper gives you Ksh 500 and you buy items for Ksh 320. Work out the change and say what to do if you are given Ksh 200 by mistake. (4 marks)

29. What is an asana? (2 marks)

30. Explain how children who find it hard to speak can join in prayers at assembly. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #17 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Light
   Wisdom is like light that clears away darkness.

2. A — With your right hand or both hands, and say thank you
   Receive with politeness.

3. A — Ya Kundendu Tushara Hara Dhavala
   This is the opening line.

4. D — Namaste
   Namaste is done with folded hands.

5. B — God
   It speaks to God as parent and friend.

6. D — Truth is worth more than wealth or comfort
   The king chose truth.

7. B — He found the owner of the purse
   He returned it.

8. B — Own up
   Owning up shows integrity.

9. A — Honest even when nobody is watching
   Integrity is honesty at all times.

10. D — Thinking small lies do not matter
   Small lies grow.

11. B — They should be thanked
   Thanking encourages honesty.

12. A — Harishchandra
   Harishchandra kept his word.

13. C — Sikhism
   Guru Nanak and Bhai Lalo.

14. D — An honest carpenter in the Guru Nanak story
   Bhai Lalo earned by honest work.

15. A — The date and the finder's name
   The book keeps a record.

16. D — By itself
   It happens on its own.

17. A — Loose and comfortable clothes
   Loose clothes help us move.

18. D — Vajra Asana
   You start sitting on heels.

19. B — It helps us breathe well and stay calm
   Yoga calms the body and mind.

20. B — In their own way, such as breathing slowly or seated poses
   Everyone can take part.

SECTION B
----
21. (4 marks)
   Answer: Doing yoga together, taking photos or videos, making a chart of asanas, making a guidance video with an adult (any four).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

22. (2 marks)
   Answer: Practise with a teacher, wear loose clothes, do it on a mat, do not do it after a big meal, stop if you feel dizzy (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

23. (2 marks)
   Answer: That the divine light guide our minds toward what is good and true (wisdom).
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for wisdom or guidance of the mind.

24. (3 marks)
   Answer: Returns extra change, pays for what he takes, brings back the correct change and does not borrow secretly.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for three points.

25. (4 marks)
   Answer: Start in Vajra Asana, breathe in and raise the arms, breathe out and bend forward, rest the forehead on the mat with arms stretched forward, breathe calmly and come up slowly.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for four correct steps.

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: You are my mother and father. You are my relative and friend. You are my knowledge and wealth. You are everything to me, O God of gods.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each pair of lines, up to 3.

27. (2 marks)
   Answer: Breathing exercises.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for breathing practice.

28. (4 marks)
   Answer: Change is 500 minus 320 = Ksh 180. If given Ksh 200, that is Ksh 20 too much, so return the Ksh 20 to the shopkeeper.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for 500 minus 320, 1 mark for 180, 1 mark for the extra 20, 1 mark for returning it.

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: A body posture.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for posture or seat.

30. (4 marks)
   Answer: They can hum, listen, join the actions or be helped by friends, so nobody is left out.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for four sensible points.
